_what: Invariant 10's ceiling, per frame directory: how many DOMAIN WORDS each may carry outside comments, counted by splitting identifiers into words. A ratchet — these numbers may fall and may not rise. Written by reading each one, never seeded blind (B-100).
_vocabulary: Two derived halves, never a hand-kept list. The nine feature directory names, from the tree: account, acquisition, arrivals, library, maintenance, media, releases, settings, system. AND the seven page aliases, parsed from lib/addresses.ts: acq, arr, cfg, lib, maint, profile, sys. The aliases were the missing half — the frame does not write `acquisition`, it writes `acq`, and app/page-host.tsx IS a table keyed by them.
_measured: 2026-08-29, by scripts/check-frame-domain.py. Three earlier readings were wrong and each was found by a mutation or a reviewer, never by re-reading the number: `\bword\b` read 53 in app/ where there are 124, because a domain word reaches the frame INSIDE an identifier; the aliases above were invisible entirely; and a module specifier was counted as an identifier, which is what put `lib` twice into a directory whose ceiling is ZERO. Re-measured 2026-08-30 at L15 phase 1, per file, by this script's own reader (`count_directory`) rather than by re-reading the printed total.

ui._why: ZERO, and it is true. `ui/` is the component vocabulary and names no subject. Its only two hits were the paths `../lib/store-access` and `../../lib/engine-drawing` — the FRAME's own lib/ directory, a word that collides with the library page's alias and means the opposite thing. A file path is not a name the code chose, so specifiers are no longer read and the count is a real zero.

lib._why: ALL SIXTEEN are in `lib/queue.ts` — the staging and acquisition queue, shared by two features, and invariant 7 is absolute so a queue both read had nowhere else to go. No other file in lib/ carries one. § 3 calls that « not one reviewed line » and hands the arbitration (a `domain/` bucket of its own) to a later wave. `lib/addresses.ts` is exempt by the invariant itself — an address IS the page's identity — and it is the ONLY exemption: `lib/engine-drawing.ts` stood here too and the invariant does not name it, so it is counted now and carries none. **RAISED TO 18 AT L11**, and it is the « one reviewed line » the invariant blesses rather than a drift: `ADDRESSES_THAT_MOVE_TOGETHER` names the two addresses THIS module's own optimistic write spans — `takeOutOfQueue` removes the card from whichever of the two lists holds it, and every online path here already invalidates both. A replay out of the offline queue has to do the same, and the pairing was first written in `app/outbox-wiring.ts`, where this guard correctly refused it: those are domain addresses and the frame may not name them. It belongs where the two-key write is MADE. The frame reads the list without knowing what is in it. It falls again with the rest of this file when the `domain/` bucket § 3 defers arrives — L16 brings its second member. **RAISED TO 23 WHEN THE LADDER LEFT THE ENGINE**, by the steward's reviewed line: `lib/navigation-entry.ts` writes the navigation entry's five page dials ONCE (`acqTab`, `libLens`, `libMode`, `libCat`, `maintTopic`) — words the exempt engine already wrote, moved rather than added. They leave when an entry stops naming page dials. **RAISED TO 28 WHEN THE ENGINE'S LIBRARY, INCOMPLETE AND SEASONS FIXTURES DIED**, pending the steward's reviewed line: `lib/membership.ts` (3 — the `/api/library/membership` read and its contract schema name) and `lib/season-rows.ts` (2 — the `/api/media/…/seasons` path) are the served reads two features and the addressed-panel table ask and none may import from another feature. They leave with the rest of this file when the `domain/` bucket arrives. **29: a take is a FOLLOW's grab (L22b phase 33, F42)** — +1, measured by this guard with the change (29) and without it (28): `ADDRESSES_THAT_MOVE_TOGETHER` gains `/api/acquisition/followed`, because a replayed `…/followed/{id}/grab` moves the same staging and queue lists the take writes to optimistically — the same reason the pair exists, one address wider.

app._why: The frame naming its PAGES, which is the exception the invariant blesses BY NAME — « whatever table the shell reads to compose navigation ». L15 made that table exist ONCE (`app/navigation.ts`, 48) where it existed four times, and the arithmetic is the whole justification: 98 − 26 (page-host.tsx, which carried the id→component list and now carries none) + 48 (the one table: id, path, component, label key, icon, group, bar, action button and badge, per page) + 1 (`app/icons.ts`, whose `library` is a drawing's name) = 121, and +7 at phase 7 for `app/drawer.tsx` (the drawer draws the same table's rows, grouped) = 128, and +1 at phase 13 for `app/entry.ts` (the sign-in gate composes the address of the page it lets through) = 129. Read file by file at phase 1: navigation.ts 48, reference.d.ts 18, router-tree.tsx 18, live-updates.ts 12, history-bridge.ts 8, engine-data.ts 7, shell.tsx 6, not-found.tsx 2, icons.ts 1, store.ts 1. The first is the table the invariant names; the next two are the list of routes and the engine seam's type slice, which every framework has somewhere; live-updates.ts is one import per feature (D-L10-1). LOWER IT WHEN THE ENGINE GOES: engine-data.ts (7) and reference.d.ts (18) die with it, and a ceiling nobody lowers becomes room for a defect nobody notices. **LOWERED TO 126 AT L19 phase 03**, and it is the sentence above being acted on rather than deferred: `engine-data.ts` loses a family every time a producer moves into its feature and declares what it needs beside itself, so it fell from 7 to 4 when `MAINT_ACTIONS` left. It is lowered in the commit that moves the producer, because a ceiling lowered later is a ceiling nobody compared. **RAISED TO 130 BY THE MOCK-LAYER MICRO-WAVE**, and it is the « one reviewed line » rather than a drift — measured at +4 exactly, by running this guard with the change removed (126) and with it (130). `app/feature-verbs.ts` is one import per feature that owns a TAP VERB — the same species as `live-updates.ts` above, and it exists because there was nowhere else: `lib/verbs.ts` holds the registry and may import no feature, a feature may import no other feature (invariant 7), and `shell.tsx` — which held the three lines — stands at the 400-line ceiling that invariant 6 says is never extended. Adding them there took it to 402. The file names no verb and no attribute: `data-rescrape` is spelled in `features/media/` and `data-maintenance-run` in `features/maintenance/`. It falls with the same movement the paragraph above describes, since a verb's installer dies with the surface that stops needing one. **RAISED TO 138 WHEN THE BOOT LEFT THE ENGINE**, by the steward's reviewed line: `app/arrival.ts` holds the interface's opening state, and eight of its words are page aliases — `page: "acq"`, `acqTab`, `libLens`, `libCat`, `libMode`, `maintTopic`, `maintBlanc`, `profile` — moved out of the exempt engine rather than added. Its keys fall when the store stops holding page dials. **RAISED TO 139 WITH THE SAME DEATH**: `app/addressed-panels.ts` imports `../lib/membership` and reads `inLibrary`, the contract's field, where the engine's `knownMedium` used to be handed in (−1 `../lib/…` never removed, net +1). **LOWERED TO 121 WHEN `window.__referentiel` DIED** (L13r phase r·5): `reference.d.ts`, the engine seam's type slice, was deleted with the object it typed (−18), measured by this guard before and after. **RAISED TO 132 WHEN THE ENGINE'S LAST CODE LEFT IT** (L13r phase r·15, ruling 112): the page restore spells the entry's dials as literal keys (ruling 102) — `page`, `acqTab`, `libLens`, `libMode`, `libCat`, `maintTopic`, each key and the value it reads, in `app/layers.ts` (+11) — because the ownership guard reads a store write's keys, and the restore moved out of the exempt engine. They fall when an entry stops naming page dials. **141: the navigation row and the route of the bar page « Découvrir » (L22b 19-bis-a, RULINGS 19)** — the operator's ruling of 2026-09-27, accepted by the steward's ruling 19: +9, measured by this guard with the change (141) and without it (132) — the navigation table's new row (its id, path, component and label key) and its component's import in `app/navigation.ts`, and the route's import and name in `app/router-tree.tsx`. A page is exactly what the invariant blesses the table for naming. **145: each badge row DECLARES the reads its badge derives from (L22b phase 28, the coherence triage's F1)** — +4, measured by this guard with the change (145) and without it (141): `useAcquisitionBadgeReads` and `useArrivalsBadgeReads`, each imported and set on its row in `app/navigation.ts`, the table the invariant names. A synchronous cache read observes nothing, so a badge whose subject no mounted component drew froze on a live event; the hook the row points at is what `app/badge-reads.tsx` — which names no feature — observes. The two `arrivals` words leave with the Arrivées row. **LOWERED TO 143 WHEN THE BOOT LIST'S QUEUE LEFT (L22b phase 29)**, measured by this guard: `app/engine-data.ts` stopped prefetching the staging and queue answers the badge rows now declare and the frame observes (−2, its `store` and the scenario it read). **147: Système's row carries its badge and declares its reads (L22b phase 30, ruling 15, OPEN 8)** — +4, measured with the change (147) and without it (143): `systemBadge` and `useSystemBadgeReads`, each imported and set on the row in `app/navigation.ts`, the same species as phase 28's. `app/menu-badge.tsx` sums the off-bar rows and names no feature.
